scope: Read all 25 passages, overviews, periods, endings, overrides and identity notes. Independently checked selected claims in 11 of 16 sources. Bounded review, not complete historical certification.

sourcesChecked.checked: Direct INALI phrase list: Elías García Aparicio attribution and Tun Kuil’ / Buenos días; public sample is expressly modern.
Indexed original INAH full account: gravity-fed Actopan water, drainage, raised platforms, Caritas decoration and Pimienta tiers. Inconsistent period label excluded.

Indexed original sections: compadrazgo networks, midwives and reported plant/temazcal practices. Public text identifies later ethnography and does not claim medical efficacy. Colonial history section not independently checked.
Indexed original UNESCO summary: house-schools, House of Elders, language instruction, art forms and reforestation of craft materials.
Direct Culture Secretariat inventory: nixtamal, metate or mill, comal, atoles and fermented maize; public text identifies regional inventory.
Indexed original INAH text: multiethnic center, tributary relations, 1519 alliance and wastewater channels towards fields. Anachronistic opening date and eclipse claim excluded.
Indexed original INAH page: repeated construction, hematite-painted Kiva, bird-headed lids and E1 burial objects; page eruption date is not adopted as certain.
Indexed original archaeological article selected passages: 3.90 metre Estela with circles and diamonds, later activity in areas free of lava. Irrigation reconstruction not independently checked.
Indexed original 2026 CATENA article sections: reused older soils and charred maize interpreted in agricultural ritual; soil age not equated to construction date.
Direct Smithsonian record: ash then lava affecting city and farmland, central circa 400 CE entry with varied radiocarbon ranges.
Direct original study repository abstract: 2016 archaeomagnetic estimate circa 90 BCE to 20 CE, presented as one interpretation.

limits: Five other sources not independently reopened; author evidence and access notes retained.
